trecho.2: DA2 (1986) contribution of conceptual richness that Brazilian concrete poetry brought to artists linked to visual poetry. An example are the Poemobiles, pieces conceived in 1973 by Augusto de Campos and the Spaniard, Julio Plaza, where a verbo-visual language adopts a three-dimensional component through interactivity. Leafing through the “book-poem” brings forth the message of a poetry with concrete roots, accompanied by movement which reaches to fill the space (21).
